From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Sent: Tuesday, September 29, 2020 8:27 AM
To: Bill DeLano <Bill@TriangleTrainingInc.com>
Subject: Re: Quiet lately. 
 
Hello Bill,

Sorry I didn't get back to you sooner. Unfortunately, I don't cover the Tigers anymore. I really appreciate you reaching out and reading over the years. I miss telling the truth to the readers. My e-mail is anthonyfenech@hotmail.com. Thanks again and be safe.

Anthony
From: Bill DeLano <Bill@TriangleTrainingInc.com>
Sent: Thursday, September 24, 2020 10:23 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Quiet lately. 
 
Anthony,
None of my business but I haven’t heard from you in regards to the Tigers lately.
I’m in NC and am used to following you. This morning, I did a search and didn’t see any announcements.
I hope you are well. I just wanted you to know that I enjoy your work and have missed your coverage.
